headline: Niger Receives First Fuel Shipment from Algeria Under Military Escort
summary: Niger received its first fuel shipment from Algeria as a 53-truck convoy carrying approximately 1.65 million liters of petroleum products arrived in Agadez under military escort.
why: Cross-border energy trade routes and regional security cooperation are vital for maintaining fuel supplies in landlocked African nations facing supply disruptions.

impacts.name: Niger
impacts.why: Securing cross-border fuel supplies alleviates domestic energy shortages.
